notes: This is a software-only MakeCode project. The only physical part is the micro:bit, and it uses its built-in buttons A and B and its LED display. No wires, breadboard or external components are needed, so there are no edges.

The program is: forever { pause 1000; pause random(4000); show image; pause 1000; clear screen; while not(A pressed) and not(B pressed) { pause 20 }; if A pressed show an arrow pointing to player A; if B pressed show an arrow pointing to player B }.
The two supplied screenshots show the `while` loop condition (`not A pressed` and `not B pressed`). They are code blocks, not circuit images.
The 'Keep score' challenge is optional and adds only variables, so it adds no hardware.
